title: Multi-Issue Credit on Returnless Damage Credits - Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders
content:
**Training note - Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders.**

A returnless damage credit carries a multi-issue credit that counts the other return authorizations on the order, in any status, whose reason is damaged, defective, wrong item or not as described. The damage report being settled is not one of the others.

| Other such return authorizations on the order | Multi-issue credit |
|---|---|
| Two or more | $2.00 |
| Exactly one | $1.00 |
| None | Nothing |

### Questions answered

**Do declined, expired or refunded authorizations count?** Yes; every status counts.

**Do changed-mind or quality-guarantee authorizations count?** No; only the four Tailwise-error reasons.

**Does the damage report being settled count itself?** No; only the other authorizations on the order.

**Example (hypothetical).** An order shows the damage report being settled, a defective authorization that was refunded and a wrong-item authorization still authorized: two others, so the multi-issue credit is $2.00.
